_note: Pay codes (earnings) for Indian payroll. Seeded once; edit on the Pay code master page. Basic + DA + retaining allowance are 'wages' under the Code on Wages (see the wage_code rule).

codes.name: Basic
codes.description: Core pay. With DA and retaining allowance it must be at least 50% of total pay (Code on Wages).

codes.name: Dearness allowance
codes.description: Cost-of-living allowance; counts as wages for PF, gratuity and bonus.

codes.name: Retaining allowance
codes.description: Paid to seasonal workers in the off season; counts as wages.

codes.name: House rent allowance
codes.description: Old regime: exempt up to the least of HRA, rent minus 10% of salary, or 50%/40% of salary.

codes.name: Conveyance allowance
codes.description: Fully taxable for salaried employees (the old Rs 1,600 exemption was replaced by the standard deduction).

codes.name: Medical allowance
codes.description: Fully taxable when paid as a fixed allowance.

codes.name: Leave travel allowance
codes.description: Old regime: exempt for domestic travel fares, two journeys in a four-year block, on proof.

codes.name: Children education allowance
codes.description: Old regime: exempt up to Rs 100 a month per child, for two children.

codes.name: Meal vouchers
codes.description: Exempt up to Rs 50 a meal during working hours.

codes.name: Telephone / internet reimbursement
codes.description: Exempt when paid against bills for official use.

codes.name: Fuel / vehicle reimbursement
codes.description: Exempt for official use on proof; taxable as a perquisite otherwise.

codes.name: Statutory bonus
codes.description: 8.33% to 20% of wages a year under the Code on Wages, for eligible employees.

codes.name: Salary arrears
codes.description: Relief under section 89 may apply in the old and new regimes (Form 10E).

codes.name: Leave encashment
codes.description: On exit: exempt up to Rs 25 lakh for non-government employees; taxable while in service.
